reference_paper.other_metrics_note: The supplied paper reference provides mean IoU only; median IoU and overlap percentages are not reported here.

phase1.method: Stage 8 CNN + classifier-weighted CAM + DFS clustering

phase2.method: Frozen Stage 8 CNN + Grad-CAM++ + Phase 1 box post-processing

ablation_summary.interpretation: Mean IoU, median IoU, and IoU > 0 improve over the baseline; IoU >= 0.5 is unchanged. The removed-component row is algorithmically the Phase 1 baseline because Grad-CAM++ map generation was the sole Stage 13 change.

conclusion: On the same 601-image test set, Phase 2 demonstrates a measurable aggregate improvement over the implemented Phase 1 CAM baseline. It does not reach the reference paper's mean IoU of 0.1508, and the high-overlap rate (IoU >= 0.5) is unchanged.
